worldcombat.skill.feintattack.summary: Slip close quietly, then blink behind the target before it can watch that side and land a heavy contact punch; it never misses because the target is not guarding that side. The Decoy option leaves a shadow double in front to hold its attention.
worldcombat.skill.feintattack.use.0: Blink behind a target and punch its back
worldcombat.skill.feintattack.use.1: Pin a target's attention on a shadow double
worldcombat.skill.feintattack.use.2: Finish a target that is watching someone else
worldcombat.skill.feintattack.descriptio: A contact punch of about %1$s; defence, type matchup and crit are settled on the hit.
Blinks behind a target within %1$s blocks, landing %2$s blocks behind it.
worldcombat.skill.feintattack.decoy.on: Decoy: leaves a shadow double in front of the target to hold its attention, then strikes from behind; windup is 4 ticks and cooldown 8 ticks longer.
worldcombat.skill.feintattack.decoy.off: Ambush: no double, just blink behind, faster and cheaper.
worldcombat.skill.feintattack.timing: Cast on an enemy within %1$s blocks; windup %2$s s then costs %4$s PP, recover %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.feintattack.growth.0: At level %1$s: punch power %2$s and blink reach %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.feintattack.growth.1: At level %1$s: punch power %2$s and decoy lasts %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.feintattack.preference: On (Decoy): leaves a shadow double in front of the target to hold its attention while striking from behind; windup is 4 ticks and cooldown 8 ticks longer. Off (Ambush): no double, just blink behind, faster and cheaper.
The user only sets up a blink on targets within this distance; larger values chase further.
On: an enemy moving away from the user (its back turned) is preferred; off: order it like a plain melee attack.
